authors: Francesco Witte, Amalia Stainchaouer, Jannik von Zabienski, Christopher Schifflechner

title: Advanced high-temperature heat pump: zeotropic mixtures and transcritical cycles (CoolProp low-level API)
description: Advanced high-temperature heat pump (zeotropic mixtures, transcritical conditions, T-s plots) - Quoilin, MIT; low-level CoolProp AbstractState API, subcritical or supercritical, pure fluids or zeotropic mixtures (default R1336mzz(Z) at p_low 10.5 bar / p_high 32 bar; Butane&Hexane selectable), secondary profiles recomputed via hx_pinch
unit_hints: script in K, Pa, J/kg - convert to SI-C at translation
notes: C-276 triage 2026-10-21: keep - no zeotropic or transcritical heat pump in the library (TSP-049 zeotropic-HP tutorial is another system, todo/low; CSL-0145 shows transcritical CO2 runs in CoolSolve). CoolSolve can reproduce it today: mixture property calls A[x]&B[y] are supported since CS-GAP-FLUIDS-MIXTURE was closed (post-v0.3.0); the script selects the REFPROP back end, which the translation replaces by EES/CoolProp fluid names (decision D12, not a gap). difficulty=hard: transcritical near-critical states, mixture composition and the phase-specified compressor outlet need good guesses. Reference: re-run advanced HTHP model.py in a venv (source-rerun). Licence MIT (repo LICENSE: Sylvain Quoilin). Proposed card C-280. C-280 done 2026-10-21: added as CSL-0253 (blocked: fluid R1336mzz(Z) missing from the CoolSolve registry, CS-GAP-FLUIDS-R1336MZZ; runnable _coolsolve variant on R365mfc verified against a source rerun).
